title: Readings in range
statement:
Keep the temperature readings that are inside the allowed range.

The input has the numbers `low` and `high`, and two arrays of readings, `morning` and `evening`. A reading is inside the range when it is at least `low` and at most `high`. Give an object with `morning` and `evening`. Each one is an array of its readings that are inside the range, in the same order.
reference:
.low as $lo | .high as $hi | def in_range: map(select(. >= $lo and . <= $hi));
{morning: (.morning | in_range), evening: (.evening | in_range)}
